# Tax Documentation: Submit W-8BEN-E Tax Documentation Data

Area overview and notes: [tax-documentation.md](../tax-documentation.md)

`POST /account-owners/{id}/tax-documentation-data/w-8ben-e` · tenant-scoped token

Submit W-8BEN-E tax documentation data for an account owner. This endpoint allows you to collect and store W-8BEN-E form information required for tax reporting and compliance for non-U.S. entities. An individual is a U.S. Person if they are a U.S. Citizen, U.S. Permanent Resident or have met the Substantial Presence Test. A business is a U.S. Person if they are organized or incorporated in the U.S.

**Path parameters**

| Name | Description |
| --- | --- |
| `id` | Your system's unique identifier for the Account Owner. |

**Request body** (required, JSON)

| `treaty_claim_rate_of_withholding` | string | No | The rate of withholding on the type of income. **Note:** The percentage as a plain number string, without a % sign: `"0"`, `"5"`, `"15"`. |
| `treaty_claim_article_paragraph` | string | No | The article and paragraph of the tax treaty. **Note:** The treaty's article reference only, without the words "Article" or "Paragraph": for example `12(1)`, `7(1)`, `21`, or `10(2)(b)`. It must match the reference Taxbit holds exactly for the treaty country and type of income; the docs' sample "Article 12, Paragraph 1" is rejected. If the claim comes back `INCOMPLETE_TREATY_CLAIM` with "not an acceptable value", the reference is wrong for that country and income type. |
| `treaty_claim_has_additional_conditions` | boolean | No | Indicates whether there are additional conditions under the treaty. **Note:** `true` when the treaty requires the claimant to meet additional conditions for this claim. Business profits and other income always do; royalties depend on the country. If the claim comes back saying additional conditions "must be checked", set it to `true`. |
| `treaty_claim_i_certify_requirements` | boolean | No | Certifies that the account owner derives the item (or items) of income for which the treaty benefits are claimed and meets the requirements of the treaty provision dealing with limitations on benefits. |
| `treaty_claim_limitation_on_benefits` | string | No | Specifies the applicable Limitation on Benefits (LOB) provision under the tax treaty that the entity qualifies for. One of: `GOVERNMENT`, `TAX_EXEMPT_PENSION`, `OTHER_TAX_EXEMPT_ORGANIZATION`, `PUBLICLY_TRADED_CORPORATION`, `SUBSIDIARY`, `COMPANY_MEETS_EROSION_TEST`, `COMPANY_MEETS_DERIVATIVE_TEST`, `COMPANY_MEETS_BUSINESS_TEST`, `FAVORABLE_DETERMINATION`, `NO_LOB_ARTICLE`, `OTHER_ARTICLE_PARAGRAPH`. |
| `treaty_claim_limitation_on_benefits_other_article_paragraph` | string | No | An explanation of the applicable Limitation on Benefits provision if “Other” is selected from the predefined list. |
| `signature` | string | No | The name signed on the form. Requires `has_signed_and_certified` to be true. When omitted, Taxbit derives the signature from `name` for individuals and stores a placeholder for entities. |
